annotations.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Embodied Spatial & Kinematics Trajectory Planner

description: Computes 3D spatial affordances, obstacle-avoidance waypoints, and manipulator grasp sequences using Gemini Robotics ER 2 embodied reasoning. Use when planning physical robot arm kinematics, mobile navigation waypoints, or spatial scene task orders; for interacting with 2D desktop or browser GUI screens, use operate_computer_use_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('coordinate_frame' defaults to 'cartesian_xyz_meters'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (150 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

coordinate_frame.description: Reference coordinate convention; defaults to 'cartesian_xyz_meters' when omitted.

prompt.description: Spatial environment description, obstacle coordinates, and physical manipulation goal.

name: plan_robotics_spatial_trajectory

coordinate_frame.description: Coordinate convention used in the output.

output.description: Synthesized trajectory plan, collision checks, and grasp sequence.

success.description: True when a collision-free trajectory was generated.
